info.name: NASA FIRMS Area Fire Detections Missing Data API
Get dates with missing satellite data

params.name: map_key
params.description: Free MAP_KEY obtained via registration at https://firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/api/map_key/. Rate limited to 5000 transactions per 10-minute interval. Larger requests (e.g., 7-day queries) may count as multiple transactions.

items.docs: Identifies dates for which satellite fire detection data is absent from the FIRMS database, organized by satellite and data type. Near Real-Time entries only appear for dates beyond the final standard processing date for each satellite.
